lines.text: If you live on a hill full of enemies, you need somewhere safe to sleep.
So you build a wooden fence around the top, but the enemy just sets it on fire.
Being an absolute genius, you replace the wood with a thick stone wall.
Congratulations! You just built a fort.
But the enemy brings ladders and climbs straight over the top.
So you dig a deep ditch all around and fill it with water. Now the ladders fall short and the climbers fall in.
But their archers shoot your guards right off the wall, so you add stone teeth along the top to hide behind.
But at the corners, they dig right under your wall.
Using your huge brain, you build round towers at every corner, so there is no blind spot to hide in.
Congratulations! You just built a fortress.
Now the only way in is the gate, so they smash it with a giant log.
So you drop a heavy iron grill behind it, and a drawbridge in front, and you pour boiling water down on anyone who gets close.
And if they still break in, everyone runs into one last tower in the middle, with its door high off the ground.
Congratulations! You just built a castle.
